name: Set a campaign's content from custom HTML
description: Store the HTML body of a draft campaign using the 'HTML custom code' editor. Best way for an agent to provide content, since it avoids the drag-and-drop editor. Other editors (drag-and-drop, simple text) and templates exist in the UI and were not captured.

editorType.description: '4' was the value for the HTML editor. Other values not mapped.

userHash.description: Per-user hash. Get it from email_campaigns.get_editor_account (field userHash). Do not log or store it.

text.description: Plain-text version generated by the server.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Saved a minimal HTML body through the editor. A direct replay with a userHash taken from get_editor_account was not tested.
